2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch introduces a per-CPU stock representation for the page_counter layer, mirroring the existing implementation in memcg. The new struct page_counter_stock_pcp preserves the functionality of its memcg equivalent and adds a backpointer to the base of the percpu stock. It also includes functions for draining, refilling, and flushing the counter, which are currently disconnected but will be connected later in the series. This patch does not introduce any functional changes and is intended as a preparatory step for further modifications.
